metadata.article_title: Compensation for accusation without reasonable cause.

article.title: Compensation for accusation without reasonable cause.
article.content: The provisions of section 250 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974) shall apply mutatis mutandis to compensation for accusation without reasonable cause before the Special Court or the Court of Session.
article.html:
445Compensation for accusation without reasonable cause.

Section 445 · Chapter XXVIII · page 243 of the Act

The provisions of section 250 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974) shall apply mutatis mutandis to compensation for accusation without reasonable cause before the Special Court or the Court of Session.
